answer.reason: Both provide HCM technology covering payroll, HR, talent and benefits administration to employers across overlapping business sizes. Both combine technology with client support. ADP’s additional outsourcing services and Paylocity’s Finance and IT offerings do not negate their direct competition in core HCM.
answer.missing_evidence: Exact revenue models and relative operating scale are not established; neither is needed to establish the evidenced product and customer overlap.
